title: Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest describing an AhaSlides slide plugin.

$schema.description: URL of this manifest's JSON Schema, used by editors for autocompletion and validation.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the UI.

icon.description: Absolute or relative path to the plugin icon asset.

baseUrl.description: Base URL where the plugin is hosted. Supports `{{VAR}}` template placeholders resolved at runtime.

staticTabs.description: Tabs registered by the plugin at fixed contexts.

slideTypes.description: Custom slide types registered by the plugin. Each entry appears in the host slide selector and provides the iframe URLs for the editor settings, presenter canvas, and audience views.

contentUrl.description: URL path (relative to `baseUrl`) rendered inside the tab.

context.description: Where this tab is shown inside the host app.

name.description: Optional display name for the tab.

type.description: Unique slide-type identifier. Stored on the slide as `slide.type`. Should not collide with built-in slide types.

name.description: Human-readable slide-type name shown in the slide selector.

desc.description: Short description shown in the slide selector.

icon.description: Absolute or relative path to the slide-type icon asset.

previewUrl.description: Optional preview image/video URL shown when hovering the slide type.

canvasUrl.description: Absolute URL of the iframe rendered on the presenter canvas. Supports `{{VAR}}` template placeholders.

settingUrl.description: Absolute URL of the iframe rendered in the editor settings panel. Supports `{{VAR}}` template placeholders.

audienceUrl.description: Absolute URL of the iframe rendered for participants in the audience app. Supports `{{VAR}}` template placeholders.

setting.description: Optional UI capability flags consumed by the host's editor settings panel. Missing keys fall back to host defaults.
